article_facts: fact:location: Darvon's Descent is a complex system of tunnels deep within the caves of Sanctuary, run by Darvon and his Changling soldiers, where the kidnapped pixies are held. | Deep within the caves of Sanctuary is a place called Darvon’s Descent. (http://www.freerealms.com:80/article/detail.action?articleId=482)

fact:location: Darvon's Descent is an underground combat quest area reached from the Memorial Caverns. | Darvon's Descent and Forgotten Caves are two exciting combat quests (http://www.freerealms.com:80/article/detail.action?articleId=144)

fact:combat: Darvon's Descent is described as one of the more difficult battles in Free Realms, especially for characters with lower level jobs; the event encouraged high-level players to group with less experienced ones. | Darvon’s Descent is one of the more difficult bat (http://www.freerealms.com:80/article/detail.action?articleId=482)

fact:event: A community event had groups take on Darvon's Descent, a cave dungeon in Sanctuary run by Darvon and his Changling soldiers, on Friday October 16 (3pm-5pm Pacific, U.S. and Latin America) and Monday October 19 (7:30am-9:30am Pacific / 4:30pm-6:30pm GMT, UK and (http://www.freerealms.com:80/article/detail.action?articleId=482)
